title: Ireland records 1,258 MW grid-scale solar generation peak ahead of eclipse
content:
The solar coaster came to Ireland this week as EirGrid recorded an all-time high peak generation followed two days later by generation lows of 8 MW during the historic solar eclipse on August 12.

title: Ukraine specifies hours eligible for rooftop PV feed-in tariff
content:
Ukraine has introduced time windows for electricity generated by household PV systems to qualify for the green tariff, with different periods applying in summer and winter. The rules also appear to prevent battery-discharged electricity outside these windows from receiving the green tariff.

title: France extends tax credit for cleantech industry for 3 years
content:
France is extending its C3IV green industry tax credit to support investment across the battery, wind, solar and heat pump value chains, as part of its reindustrialization strategy. The extension is expected to support around 40 projects by 2030.

title: India on track for record 50 GW of solar installations in 2026
content:
India is on track to install a record 50 GW of solar capacity in 2026, driven by a rush to meet the ALMM-II deadline despite emerging cell supply constraints. Wood Mackenzie expects the resulting supply crunch to push system prices higher through 2027, while greater domestic manufacturing capacity gradually eases pressure.

content:
Relectrify has installed its first inverterless AC1 battery energy storage system in Renmark, South Australia in collaboration with SA-based turnkey renewable energy solutions company YES Energy.

title: The world’s most efficient solar panel goes on sale later this year
content:
Solar manufacturer Tandem PV has secured nearly $1 billion in Letter of Intent (LOI) agreements for its next-generation solar modules. The high-efficiency panels feature a perovskite-silicon 4T (four-terminal) design. The company sees a clear path to increasing efficiency by 2% annually reaching 37% by 2030.

title: Off-grid in Angola
content:
Portugal’s MCA group has switched on two large-scale off-grid solar-plus-storage projects in Angola since December 2025. Carlo Amado, the company’s chief operating officer of energies, spoke to pv magazine about how the projects fit into Angola’s rural electrification program, which aims to build 46 autonomous solar and storage minigrids to provide reliable electricity to 60 communities across six provinces.

title: Origin Energy’s 650MWh Mortlake BESS begins commercial operations in Australia
content: Origin Energy has confirmed that its 300MW/650MWh Mortlake BESS in south-west Victoria has commenced commercial operations.

title: Squadron Energy secures AU$2.7 billion refinancing to support hybrid asset growth in Australia
content: Squadron Energy has completed a refinancing of its Australian renewable energy portfolio, securing total debt commitments of more than AU$2.7 billion (US$1.76 billion).

title: Edify Energy reaches financial close on 1,200MWh solar-plus-storage projects in Queensland, Australia
content: Australian developer Edify Energy has reached financial close on the Ganymirra and Majors Creek solar-plus-storage projects near Townsville in North Queensland, featuring 360MWp of solar generation and 300MW/1,200MWh of battery storage.
